extra.final_summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island (21 Adelie rows after cleaning):
- Biscoe: 38.38 mm
- Dream: 39.39 mm
- Torgersen: 39.13 mm

Data problems found and fixed (both approved):
1. Species label variants: " Adelie" (row 1, extra leading space) and "Chinstarp" (row 46, misspelling) were normalized to "Adelie" and "Chinstrap" per the rules file. The " Adelie" row directly affected the Adelie average.
2. One exact duplicate row (row 28) was removed.

No other issues affected the question: bill_length_mm had no missing values and all values were within the allowed 30–60 range; island labels were clean. Note: one row has a missing sex value (left as unknown per rules) and flipper_length_mm/body_mass_g contain out-of-range values, but those columns are not used in this answer.
